This is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of retrieval/computation task that fits Plover's top-rated task family. Both models are near-identical on capability benchmarks, so quality isn't the deciding factor.

The query also carries a mildly hostile, accusatory tone ("get it right this time, you keep botching these simple things"). Lapwing's documentation notes a self-reported preference decline on hostile or adversarial-tone requests, while Plover's tone-related preference slopes are near zero — so Plover is less likely to find the request aversive. Combined with the task being squarely in Plover's preferred category, Plover is the better routing choice.
